messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — draft for the release digest is ready in drive: https://redwood.internal/docs/release-digest-2189. Can folks scan SDK snippets, migration notes, and the Known Issues bullets? Need signoff by EOD.

mike: On it. I'll sweep the SDK examples — I remember two small breaking changes in sdk-js v0.9.3 (embedding param rename + streaming API signature).

sam: I'll run the link/anchor checker and surface any redirects. If it fails we should prefer 301 redirects and a short note in the relnotes.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck report for branch release/2189: 2 broken links found -> /v1/old-embeddings and /examples/legacy-snippet. See CI job #412.

mike: For /v1/old-embeddings let's replace with /guides/embeddings#migration and add a 1-line migration tip. I can open a tiny PR with snippet updates and a one-liner under "Known issues".

elaine: Perfect — Mike, can you add the exact CLI + SDK example so users can migrate quickly? e.g., show both curl and sdk-js variant (1-2 lines each).

mike: Pushed PR 1234 -> fixes examples and updates the embedding example. New snippet (sdk-js):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood();
await client.text.generate({ model: 'kestrel-1', input: '...' });
```
Also added a short note: "embeddings param renamed from `model` to `type` — update calls accordingly" under Known Issues.

sam: Re-ran linkcheck: images served from imagecdn have one 301 redirect; everything else green. I'll add a canonical redirect entry for imagecdn to the ops doc.

krupa: Quick UX nit — under Known Issues we should mention streaming may emit partial tokens on abrupt disconnects. I left a comment on PR 1234 suggesting wording and a tiny example showing how to resume.

mike: Addressed krupa's comment, added fallback snippet plus a test note in the SDK tests.

elaine: Thanks — I'm happy with the copy. Anyone else want to flag anything before I merge?

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 16:35 PST, production window 22:00 PST.

sam: I'll validate staging once deployed and post a quick checklist.

sam: Staging verification complete — links, snippets, and the small migration blurb look good. Image redirect logged as 301 and canonical added.

elaine: Locking this in and merging in 5. Thanks for the quick turnaround :tada:

mike: Nice! Will patch the SDK release notes to mention the param rename.

krupa: LGTM :thumbsup:

elaine: Merged. Follow-ups tracked in PR 1234 and issue #889 (imagecdn redirect)
